typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AMERIGROUP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		COUNTY as string,
		PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		Prior_enrollment_in_GF360 as string,
		Date_of_last_ER_admission as string,
		Date_of_last_Inpatient_treatment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   [AMERIGROUP_ID], [MEMBER_FIRST_NAME], [MEMBER_LAST_NAME], [CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME], [CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME], [CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER], [MEMBER_DOB], [COUNTY], [PRODUCT_NAME], [SUB_PRODUCT_NAME], [MEMBER_AGE], [Prior_enrollment_in_GF360], [Date_of_last_ER_admission], [Date_of_last_Inpatient_treatment] FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.GA_GOMO_PRESERVATION_EXTRACT	 WHERE [ELIGIBLE_RECORD] = \'Y\' ORDER BY [MEMBER_FIRST_NAME]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableGAGOMOPRESERVATIONEXTRACT
SourceTableGAGOMOPRESERVATIONEXTRACT derive(AMERIGROUP_ID = AMERIGROUP_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		Date_of_last_ER_admission as string,
		PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		Prior_enrollment_in_GF360 as string,
		Date_of_last_Inpatient_treatment as string,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME as string,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEMBER_AGE as string,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME as string,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		AMERIGROUP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		COUNTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_FIRST_NAME,
		Date_of_last_ER_admission,
		PRODUCT_NAME,
		Prior_enrollment_in_GF360,
		Date_of_last_Inpatient_treatment,
		CAREGIVER_LAST_NAME,
		SUB_PRODUCT_NAME,
		MEMBER_LAST_NAME,
		MEMBER_AGE,
		CAREGIVER_FIRST_NAME,
		CAREGIVER_PHONE_NUMBER,
		AMERIGROUP_ID,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		COUNTY)) ~> TargetGoMoPreservation
